html:
The Battle of Al Wajbah was fought in March 1893 near Doha, when Qatari forces under Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani defeated an Ottoman force sent to bring him to heel.

The Ottomans had a garrison in Doha and wanted to collect taxes and appoint officials. Jassim refused and withdrew to the fort at Al Wajbah. The Ottoman column that marched on it was beaten and retreated.

The Ottomans stayed in Doha until the First World War, but they never again tried to rule Qatar directly. Qataris count the battle as the moment the country stood on its own, between the Ottomans, the British and Bahrain.
sum: The Battle of Al Wajbah was fought in March 1893 near Doha, when Qatari forces under Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani defeated an Ottoman force sent to bring him to heel.
